description: Epic tracking all work needed to make firefly-forage sandboxing fully functional on macOS using the Apple Container backend (Virtualization.framework). Current state: basic container lifecycle works (create/start/stop/destroy), but critical capabilities are missing — no Nix store integration, no generated file injection, no network isolation, incomplete darwin.nix module, and minimal test coverage.
title: macOS sandboxing: end-to-end functional capability
